reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The operation involves the provision of a non-recourse long-term senior project financing in favour of Egur Solar Kft., Holmu Solar Kft., Pata Solar Kft., Urus Solar Kft. and Zenu Solar Kft. (the "Borrowers"), limited liability companies incorporated in Hungary for the development, construction and operation of solar photovoltaic and co-located battery energy storage systems ("BESS"). The Borrowers are fully owned by Renalfa IPP GmbH (the "Sponsor"), a Vienna-based renewables developer. The operation will enable the Borrowers to develop, construct and operate a portfolio of 450 MW solar PV and 250 MW / 1,000 MWh co-located BESS in northeastern Hungary (the "Project").
